title: Qwnks's Better Adventures
description: Qwnk's Better Adventures (Q.B.A) aims to greatly enhance Minecraft in many different ways, by adding new structures, mechanics, and even systems!
body:
# Qwnks's Better Adventures!

## General Information
**Qwnks's Better Adventures** goal is to greatly enhance **Minecraft** while remaining **Optimized**, **Easy To Run**, and not being **Bloated**

## Features Farmer's Delight, Flowing Fluids, Homeostatic, Frostiful, & Scorchful
**Qwnks's Better Adventures** features **Farmer's Delight**, **Flowing Fluids**, **Homeostatic**, **Frostiful**, and **Scorchful**. which adds new **food types**, **tools**, **recipes**, **temperature mechanics**, **temperature gauge**, and **water physics** changes

## Up To Date
**Qwnks's Better Adventures** will receive major updates every 1-2 months and minor updates/patches every 2 weeks to ensure mods are up to date and remain compatible!

## Built On Fabric
**Qwnks's Better Adventures** uses **Fabric mod loader** which is **lightweight**, **fast**, and supports a whole bunch of mods!

## Open Devlopment 
Most if not all the mods in **Qwnks's Better Adventures** are **open source**, which means this modpack is too!

## FAQ 

- **Q:** What mods does the modpack have?
  - **A:** Click on any version and just scroll down!

- **Q:** What's the difference between **Qwnks's Console Experience** & **Qwnks's Better Adventures**?
- - **A: Split into two parts: 1 & 2** 
  - **1:** **Qwnks's Console Experience** is aimed at enhancing **Minecraft** while remaining **Lightweight** & **Mostly Vanilla**, like it could run on a **console** in a sense.
    
   - **2:** **Qwnks's Better Adventures** on the other hand aims to greatly enhance **Minecraft** by adding new **structures**, **mechanics**, and **systems** while remaining **Optimized**, **Easy to Run**, and without feeling too **Bloated**!

- **Q:** How Can I Contribute?
  -  **A:** Click On Our Donation Link(s)!
